h1: Bed Hub Hotel Phichit — spacious, clean, minimalist rooms at a budget price
intro: Among Phichit's budget stays, Bed Hub Hotel is one of the names real reviews speak most warmly about — a small two-storey hotel with a garden in the Khlong Khachen area of Mueang Phichit. Its draw is rooms that feel larger than the price suggests, with a clean dark-grey minimalist look, private balconies, fridges and LCD TVs. There are 30 rooms, large parking, strong Wi-Fi throughout and a free hot pork-porridge breakfast. Rates start from approx. THB 550/night, making it a popular pick for travellers driving through or visiting town on business.

body.html: What sets Bed Hub apart from the usual few-hundred-baht stays in Phichit is rooms that feel larger than expected at this price. Real reviews agree: big rooms, a large comfortable bed, and a clean, modern dark-grey minimalist look rather than the tired feel of older budget hotels. Every room has air conditioning, a fridge, an LCD TV and a private balcony overlooking the garden. The building is a two-storey house wrapped around a garden, with a quiet atmosphere that suits travellers who actually want to rest.

Another point reviews praise is the strong Wi-Fi that covers the whole property. Anyone who needs to work or take an online call on the road will appreciate it, since at this price the connection often drops elsewhere. Cleanliness is good, with repeated mentions of tidy rooms and a calm, quiet atmosphere. The hotel's parking is large and fits several cars — a real advantage for anyone arriving by car.
"The room was bigger than I expected for five-hundred-odd baht, big comfy bed, clean and quiet, strong Wi-Fi everywhere. The parking is huge — perfect for a one-night stop while driving through."

Breakfast is included and kept simple but filling — hot pork porridge, a fried egg, tea and coffee in the morning. It isn't a big buffet, but many guests say a hot bowl of porridge before hitting the road is just right and well worth the room rate. There's a 7-Eleven nearby and food delivery is available if you'd like more than that.

To be straight about it: the location is in Khlong Khachen, about 4 kilometres from central Phichit. It isn't next to the market or a walkable nightlife strip, so without your own transport you'll want to plan meals and supplies ahead, as the shops around aren't dense. That same trait is a plus for anyone driving north–south through town — easy access to the main road and plenty of parking — but if you want to walk straight into the city, an in-town hotel like The Nest or Phichit Plaza will serve you better.

A small note from reviews: you may occasionally hear housekeeping during the late morning, and as a small hotel there's no full on-site restaurant. But weighed against the spacious, clean rooms, large parking, strong Wi-Fi and budget rate, most guests find it easy to live with and still recommend it. Bed Hub scores around 4 out of 5 on Tripadvisor and ranks near the top of Phichit's B&B/guesthouse-style stays.

In short, Bed Hub Hotel suits travellers driving through, people in town on business, or budget travellers who want a clean, spacious room for very little. It isn't a luxury hotel and the location isn't central, but on value, room size and cleanliness it does its job better than many of the province's other few-hundred-baht stays.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Bed Hub Hotel Phichit

faq.q: Where is Bed Hub Hotel in Phichit and what's nearby?
faq.a: Bed Hub Hotel is at 24 Moo 7, Khlong Khachen, Mueang Phichit. It's within the city district but about 4 km (around 8 minutes by car) from the central market area. It sits near the main road with easy access and a 7-Eleven nearby — arriving by car is the most convenient, thanks to the large parking.

faq.q: What are the starting prices and room types at Bed Hub Hotel?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. THB 550/night for a Standard Room that's larger than you'd expect at this price. Superior and Deluxe rooms run around THB 700–850. Every room has AC, a fridge, an LCD TV and a balcony, and breakfast (pork porridge) is included. Compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Bed Hub Hotel have parking and Wi-Fi?
faq.a: Yes to both. Free parking with a large lot for several cars, and free Wi-Fi that is strong across the property. Both come up often in real reviews, making it a good fit for self-drivers and anyone who needs to work online while travelling.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Bed Hub Hotel?
faq.a: Rooms are larger than the price suggests, with big comfortable beds and a clean, modern dark-grey minimalist look. Each has AC, a fridge, an LCD TV and a private garden-view balcony. Cleanliness is good and the atmosphere quiet — one note is occasional housekeeping noise in the late morning.

faq.q: What is breakfast like at Bed Hub Hotel, and is it included?
faq.a: Breakfast is included and kept simple but filling — hot pork porridge, a fried egg, tea and coffee in the morning. It's not a large buffet but is just right before setting off. For more options there's a 7-Eleven nearby and food delivery is available.

faq.q: Who is Bed Hub Hotel best suited for?
faq.a: It suits travellers driving north–south through town, people in Phichit on business, and budget travellers who want a clean, spacious room for very little. If you don't have a car or want to walk into the centre, consider The Nest Hotel or Phichit Plaza in town instead.
